**Estimated agent cost:** ~$0.50 (~90k tokens, estimate)

- Model: the session model. No escalation.
- Gate route: local build on Windows, trial-merged with main 058e14ca0. The lane lost the completion note for this review, so the token total is an estimate from comparable reviews.

Blended upper estimate at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower.

@NeoTech Review fixes in `48bfe892` (after your review, rebased onto `085a4717`):

1. **Near plane**: ortho branch now uses `near = -((dist * 20.0).max(1000.0) - ORTHO_EYE_DIST)`.
2. **New test**: `the_ortho_projection_keeps_a_point_in_front_of_the_eye_plane` — `dist = 300`, point at `target + 150 * back`, asserts `0.0 <= z / w <= 1.0` ("the point in front of the eye plane must survive").
3. **Body lines**: Changelog added; no issue covers this viewport bug yet (you said the maintainer will file one).

`law_tests.rs::the_ortho_depth_spans_zero_to_one_between_the_planes` updated to the new formula. `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` — 803 passed, 0 failed. Clippy clean. A maintainer will handle the merge; nothing else pending from our side.

Note from the maintenance lane. Our review agent set this PR to draft. That was our error: a fork PR stays as its contributor set it. The PR is ready again. The `conflicts` label is true: the head 48bfe892e conflicts with current main in the `eye()` function (main added `frame.to_world` rotation in the same lines). What the author must do: merge current main into the branch and resolve `eye()` to keep both sides (main's rotation with the PR's mode-selected distance `d`). The code review itself is clean: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/1689#pullrequestreview-5946226694

Thank you for this contribution. This comment tells you what happens next with this PR, and why.

The maintainer decided on 2026-11-18 that the project completes an outside PR when its last author activity is more than 24 hours old. The purpose is to get your work into `main` and not to let it wait behind conflicts. This PR is in that group.

What we do:
- An agent of this repository merges `main` into your branch and corrects the open review findings. Your commits stay as they are. We do not rebase and we do not force-push.
- The agent pushes to your branch, because this PR permits edits by maintainers.
- A different agent reviews the result. The PR merges when that review is clean.
- Each step gets a comment on this PR.

If you want to do this work yourself, write a comment here. Then we stop and the PR stays with you.

This PR is a draft again. The merge of `main` into the branch had hand edits. The edited file is `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs` (`Camera::eye`). A refresh with hand edits is new work, so the PR needs a delta review before it is flagged ready again.

Merged `main` into the branch to remove the conflicts.

- New head: `7e83321519aef24782901450ce7981ba2950f426` (merge of `origin/main` at `110aca435`).
- Conflict: `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs`, `Camera::eye`.
  - `main` (c620c1255, #1993) maps the eye offset through `self.frame.to_world(...)`.
  - This PR uses the distance `d` (`ORTHO_EYE_DIST` in orthographic mode, else `self.dist`).
  - Resolution: keep the two changes. The offset goes through `self.frame.to_world(...)` and uses `d` for its length.
- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`, `-j 6`): 4 steps, 0 failed.
  - ui build (--no-run): ok
  - ui suites: lib: ok
  - ui suites: catalog_render: ok
  - ui suites: gpu_render: ok
- `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 1689 --reviewed 48bfe892e`: DELTA. The merge needs a delta review of `git show --remerge-diff 7e8332151`.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7e83321519aef24782901450ce7981ba2950f426 -->
Read-only delta review (Opus, remerge-diff only, not built) of the merge 7e83321519aef24782901450ce7981ba2950f426. The review of 48bfe892e stays valid for the other code.

Verdict: no blockers

What I checked:

1. `git show --remerge-diff 7e8332151` shows one hand-resolved hunk only. It is in `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs`, `Camera::eye`. No other file has a hand edit.
2. The resolution keeps the two sides. The offset goes through `self.frame.to_world(...)` (main, #1993). The length is `d` (the PR: `ORTHO_EYE_DIST` in orthographic mode, else `self.dist`). See `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs:1343-1356`.
3. `git diff 110aca435 7e8332151 --stat` (the main parent against the merge) shows only the PR's two files: `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs` and `crates/ui/src/law_tests.rs`. Nothing of main is lost. The other differences against the current `origin/main` (`assets/posts/tormach.cps`, `crates/post/tests/tormach_no_a_word.rs`, `docs/decisions/2473-tormach-a-without-word.md`) come from #2490, which merged to main after this merge.
4. `ViewFrame::to_world` (`crates/ui/src/view_frame.rs:49-55`) is a pure rotation. `Mill` is the identity. `Lathe` maps `(x, y, z)` to `(z, y, -x)`: an orthonormal matrix with determinant +1, with no translation and no scale. Thus the eye stays at the length `d` from the target in each frame. The near-plane formula `near = -((dist * 20.0).max(1000.0) - ORTHO_EYE_DIST)` (`crates/ui/src/viewport.rs:1438`) measures depth along the view axis from the eye. It does not depend on the orbit frame. The PR's tests in `crates/ui/src/law_tests.rs` stay consistent with the merged eye.
5. No second eye-distance calculation exists. `Camera::eye` is the only place in `crates/ui/src` that builds the eye offset from yaw and pitch. `fwd`, `basis_right`, `basis_up`, `mvp`, `ray` and `dolly_cursor` all read `self.eye()`. The #1993 tests in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/lathe_view.rs` assert directions only, not an eye distance.

Findings:

- None in the delta.
- The PR body has no before/after screenshot. This is a UI PR. The house rule asks for screenshots before `/merge-ready` offers it. This is not a code blocker.

The PR is ready and merges now, on the maintainer's order of 2026-11-18.

- Head: `7e83321519aef24782901450ce7981ba2950f426`. No push came after the delta review.
- Class: DELTA. The merge of `main` had one conflict that was resolved by hand, in `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs` (`Camera::eye`).
- Reviews that this merge relies on: the review of `48bfe892e` (review 5946226694) for the change, and the read-only delta review of the merge in comment 6975474177, verdict "no blockers".
- Gate: the quick gate on the merged tree was green, 4 steps.
- Screenshots: the maintainer decided that this PR merges without a before and after screenshot. The change is a camera near-plane fix with no page change.

Thank you for the fix.
